notes: Stamina drains about 22% slower (attacks, misses, dodges, dashes, counters and charging all cost less), and guards break about 25% sooner when they're hit. Everything looks punchier: every fighter, player and car now has a rim of light around its edges that picks up the arena's colour (cool blue in the Octagon, warm on the court, purple in the city), a richer colour grade, and a soft cinematic vignette.
